narrative.overview:
WorkBuddy EMS is a precision instrument for employee management — a cockpit where every gauge, switch, and indicator earns its place through utility. The visual language communicates calm authority: the admin who opens this system at 9 AM should immediately feel oriented, informed, and in control.

But precision does not mean cold. The modern & inviting mood lives in the details: the warm teal that greets you on the login brand panel, the confident weight of a primary button press, the gentle amber glow of a pickup card. Rounded corners (8–14px) keep surfaces friendly without feeling casual. The system sits between sterile enterprise and flashy consumer.
keyCharacteristics: Scanability first — tables, stat cards, and status chips designed for rapid visual parsing
Tactile confidence — buttons have weight, cards feel solid, inputs respond clearly
Flat & tonal depth — surfaces layered through color tint and borders, not heavy shadows
Warm precision — Trust Teal as a living presence, semantic colors for instant recognition
India-native details — statutory labels and local operational patterns as first-class content

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Trust Teal appears on at most one primary action per viewport. Its rarity is what makes it powerful.

rules.name: The Ghost Border Rule
rules.body: When a surface needs separation but shadows feel too heavy, use a 1px border in --line color. It defines edges without adding visual weight.

rules.name: The Weight Ladder Rule
rules.body: Only three weights in the system: 400 (body), 600 (labels, emphasis), 700–800 (headlines, numbers). Never use 500 or 300.

rules.name: The No-Scroll Shell Rule
rules.body: The app shell uses 100vh with overflow hidden — only the content area scrolls. Sidebar and topbar stay fixed.

rules.name: The Pill Doctrine
rules.body: Tags, status indicators, and tab controls always use fully rounded pills (999px). This creates a consistent visual language for small classification elements.

dos: Do use Trust Teal as the single primary accent — one primary action per viewport.
Do use 1px borders in --line color as the primary edge definition between surfaces.
Do use pill-shaped tags (999px radius) with semantic color tints for all status classification.
Do maintain the 44px minimum tap target on all interactive elements.
Do use Plus Jakarta Sans exclusively — express hierarchy through weight and size.
Do use color-mix() for tinted backgrounds — 12% for good/red, 14% for amber, 18% for focus rings.
donts: Don't use emoji anywhere in the UI — lucide-react SVG icons with aria-labels only.
Don't use heavy drop shadows for depth — the system is flat & tonal.
Don't introduce additional border radii beyond the graduated scale (4/8/10/12/14/999px).
Don't use more than three font weights in any context (400/600/700–800).
Don't make interactive elements rely on hover alone for state communication.
Don't use raw hex colors in component styles — always reference CSS custom properties.
Don't create decorative gradients or glassmorphism effects.
